sun_dogs.lore: Bright spots stand either side of the low sun. The cold will not break tomorrow.

light_pillars.lore: Pillars of light climb off the chimneys into still air. It will be clear and colder by morning.

aurora.lore: A green glow lifts in the north at dusk. The sky is open and the night is long.

smoke_straight.lore: Stove smoke rises straight as a post. High pressure; clear tomorrow.

smoke_flat.lore: The smoke sinks and spreads along the roof. A front is coming within the half day.
